name: red-couture-cupid-editorial
image_vibe: Glossy monochrome-red cupid fantasy with sculptural heart installation and controlled luxury drama
image_purpose: Create a high-fashion Valentine or fantasy campaign key visual.

prompt.project_info: An ultra-realistic vertical 3:4 high-fashion editorial portrait of an original adult woman standing beside a massive satin red heart installation.
prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with dark hair in soft glamorous waves, luminous natural skin with a refined editorial glow, defined eyes, saturated red lips, and a composed powerful expression. She wears a structured non-transparent red corset top, glossy red satin or vinyl above-knee skirt, long red gloves, opaque red tights, red patent heels, a minimalist gold choker, and glossy red cupid wings. She holds a stylized fashion arrow.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical 3:4 framing, subject standing beside a floor-standing massive heart taller than her, gaze slightly downward, figure clearly separated from the clean red studio background, several elegant stylized arrows distributed across the heart like an art installation, and a slightly reflective red floor.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Subdued red studio ambience with the subject and heart brighter than the background, strong contour light along wings, arrows, glossy fabrics, satin heart, skirt, and hair, cinematic high-contrast monochrome-red luxury mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-fashion editorial, full-body vertical composition, realistic satin, vinyl, glove, opaque-tights, wing, metallic-arrow, and skin texture, subtle film grain, natural optical falloff, high-resolution clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create an ultra-realistic vertical 3:4 high-fashion editorial portrait of an original adult woman standing beside a massive satin red heart installation. Give her dark hair in soft glamorous waves, luminous natural skin with refined editorial glow, defined eyes, saturated red lips, and a composed powerful expression. Dress her in a structured non-transparent red corset top, glossy red satin or vinyl above-knee skirt, long red gloves, opaque red tights, red patent high heels, a minimalist gold choker, and glossy red cupid wings. Have her hold a stylized fashion arrow and gaze slightly downward. Set the scene in a minimalist red studio with a slightly reflective red floor; make the heart taller than the subject with rich red satin texture, refined glossy sheen, and several elegant non-aggressive arrows with metallic tips distributed like an art installation. Use subdued ambient lighting, brighter subject and heart, strong contour light, cinematic high-contrast monochrome-red grading, realistic materials, subtle film grain, high-resolution editorial clarity, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, sexualized pose, aggressive weapon use, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, malformed heart, malformed wings, warped arrows, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, text

assets.name: source red cupid couture scene
assets.usage: Use only as optional guidance for red cupid styling, heart installation, arrows, wings, monochrome studio, and contour lighting; do not copy identity.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Preserve the adult subject, red couture silhouette, cupid wings, stylized arrows, massive satin heart, red studio, and luxury editorial intent. Identity and non-essential installation details may vary.

changes: Clarified the subject as an original adult and specified non-transparent coverage while preserving the couture silhouette and concept.
